title: Extending an affine linear section map from a quasi-coherent source
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $P,Q$ sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $V\subseteq X$ an affine open [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Assume $P$ is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent]; no quasi-coherence of $Q$ is assumed. Put $R=\mathcal O_X(V)$. For every $R$-linear map $f:P(V)\to Q(V)$ there is a sheaf morphism $\varphi:P|_V\to Q|_V$ whose component on $V$ is $f$, so $\varphi_V(b)=f(b)$ for every $b\in P(V)$. Restriction is the module-over-opens construction of [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions].

source.place: Lemma 01I7 (lemma-compare-constructions), mapping property; Lemma 01IB (lemma-equivalence-quasi-coherent); applied to the sheaf-morphism construction in Properties, Lemma 01PM.

proof.text: Restrict P and Q to the affine scheme V using Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor; restriction preserves quasi-coherence. Push these modules along the isomorphism V.toSpecΓ. The pushforward of the source is quasi-coherent: it is isomorphic to restriction along the inverse isomorphism, by restrictFunctorId, restrictFunctorCongr, restrictFunctorComp and restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso. On Spec R, define the extension as inv P.fromTildeΓ followed by tilde.map of the section map followed by Q.fromTildeΓ. The source counit is invertible by Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent; no condition on Q is used. The identities toOpen_fromTildeΓ_app and tilde.toOpen_map_app prove the desired equality on global sections. The ΓSpecIso identity for toSpecΓ.appTop identifies the scalar actions.

Use Scheme.Modules.overEquiv and overFunctorEquiv to conjugate the restricted morphism and take the fully faithful functor preimage, obtaining P.over V to Q.over V. Apply map_preimage at the top open. Its component reduces to the original morphism at V.ι image top; transport along V.ι_image_top to get the asserted value f(b) at V. This is equality transport only and applies unchanged when V is empty or either module is zero.

proof_origin.place: Mapping property of Lemma 01I7 and affine equivalence of Lemma 01IB, implemented using Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.Tilde and Modules.Sheaf; the Spec/global affine extension calculations adapt the proved source-library Modules.FaithfullyFlatDescent and Modules.AffineHom proofs without their unused target quasi-coherence assumptions.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_section_linear_map_extension
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (P Q : X.Modules) [P.IsQuasicoherent]
    (V : X.affineOpens) (f : Γ(P, V.1) →ₗ[Γ(X, V.1)] Γ(Q, V.1)) :
    ∃ φ : P.over V.1 ⟶ Q.over V.1,
      ∀ b : Γ(P, V.1), φ.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (le_refl V.1)))) b =
        f b
